# Google Arts & Culture

> Google Arts & Culture democratizes access to the world's artistic and cultural heritage through virtual museum collections, interactive experiences, and curated stories from 2000+ partner institutions.

The platform combines Street View technology with machine learning to create immersive explorations of art, architecture, and cultural history. It serves as a bridge between global museums and audiences, offering both passive viewing and interactive educational games.

## Key Topics

- Virtual Museums
- Art History
- Cultural Heritage
- Interactive Experiences
- Museum Collections

## Core Platform

- [Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com): Homepage for Google Arts & Culture platform featuring 2000+ museums and cultural institutions worldwide
- [Explore](https://artsandculture.google.com/explore): Main exploration interface with art collections, themes, and interactive tools for discovering cultural content
- [Collections](https://artsandculture.google.com/partner): Directory of partner museum collections including MoMA, Van Gogh Museum, National Gallery of Art, and The J. Paul Getty Museum
- [Themes](https://artsandculture.google.com/project): Curated cultural themes and projects across geographic locations and historical periods

## Interactive Experiences & Games

- [Play with Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/play): Interactive games and AI experiments for art exploration and educational engagement
- [Viola the Bird](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/viola-the-bird/nAEJVwNkp-FnrQ): Interactive ML-powered musical instrument experiment by David Li combining art and technology
- [Don't Touch the Art at the National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/don-t-touch-the-art-at-the-national-gallery-of-art-washington-d-c/6gFFxOZaOc9WwQ): Interactive gravity-defying arcade game featuring National Gallery of Art artworks

## Artist & Museum Spotlights

- [Artist Spotlight: Who is Vermeer?](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/wAVh9qgAIQbaWA): Biographical facts about Dutch painter Vermeer and his artistic legacy
- [Journey through Europe with Vincent van Gogh](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/uQVBmtH-98NxTA): Interactive story exploring Van Gogh's European travels and biographical journey
- [Jacques-Louis David's Mythical Napoleon](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/-QXh_K01f2ELiA): In-depth analysis of David's Napoleon portrait and its historical context
- [14 Artworks about Love at the National Gallery](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/wgUxJzEh-91VNQ): Curated collection of romantic artworks from National Gallery of Art

## Architectural & Cultural Heritage Tours

- [Artistic Masterpieces, Beautiful Museums](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/NQUhNibOYWFcxA): Curated guide to world-renowned museums and their architectural masterpieces
- [Explore the Historic Mosque City of Bagerhat](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/egUBeOz-kdEgUg): Virtual tour of Bagerhat's medieval Islamic architecture and heritage sites in Bangladesh
- [7 Amazing Things You Never Knew About Venice](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/zwXxQwghHbWjLg): Historical facts and architectural secrets about Venice and its cultural heritage

## Cultural History Stories

- [400 Years of Tempeh](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/ewVxU_e7OUS4_Q): Cultural history of Indonesian tempeh and its evolution over centuries
